roles.title: Quant Trading and Machine Learning Associate 2026
roles.eligibility: MSc or PhD in Mathematical/Quantitative subject (Maths, Physics, CS, Engineering, Quant Finance)
roles.requirements: Object-oriented programming (Python, C++, Java); 1-year programme with two 6-month rotations in Markets Front Office
roles.notes: Collaborating with traders on risk assessments, strategies, trading ideas. Bloomberg/Reuters/proprietary tools training.
